text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 400, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "sales from red hats were $400"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half the total amount she earned from selling green hats"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4 of the total sales of the first month"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4 of the total sales of the first month"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "the $400 of red hats is half of the green-hat sales"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "the first month's total sales"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "the fraction 3/4"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "the second month is 3/4 of the first month"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "both months together"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "the total amount Ariadne made in the two months"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "'in two months' says how many months to add up; each month's total is worked out separately"}]}
